proposal.hypothesis: LiBF4 is a closed-shell tetrafluoroborate with Li+ and BF4-; B-F bonding should give a wide-gap insulator with no redox-accessible cations, resisting oxidation at 4 V and limiting decomposition at LiCoO2/Li3InCl6 interfaces.
proposal.motivation: Earlier evaluated fluorides LiF, Li3AlF6, LiMgAlF6, and Li2ZrF6 achieved penalty_bin 0, while Li2SiF6 and LiTaF6 gave penalty_bin 1, suggesting stable main-group fluorides are promising.
